name: Plain Baked Sweet Potato (Peeled Flesh Only)
whyItWorks: Sweet potato flesh is packed with beta-carotene, vitamin C, and predominantly soluble fiber. When baked until caramel-sweet and tender, it provides gentle anti-inflammatory nourishment for the intestinal lining.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pierce sweet potato with a fork and microwave for 6–8 minutes or bake at 400°F for 45 minutes until soft. Scoop out only the orange flesh; completely discard the tough outer skin.
watchOuts: Always discard the tough, fibrous outer peel.
